mostWorthwhile.text: Configuring and installing the address display was most worthwhile: a Tin Row rider finding the workshop made the local infrastructure feel useful to a person.

leastWorthwhile.text: Opening the shutter with the residents' fobs was straightforward progress, but less interesting than setting up the address display.

surprise.text: The display needed the local controller before it could be installed; the compatibility feedback revealed and performed that setup.

arbitrary.text: The fob opening the workshop shutter felt a little unexplained, though the result made its purpose clear.

continue.text: Yes. The tangible consequences of the local address and the connection to Tin Row make me curious about what the neighborhood would build next.
